* '''Original''' (this page): Alternate-image card image first published 24 February 2024<ref name="img-o">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d660492911547170d55af7c4f2a7d4aad605ec2a/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png holotable commit d660492], 24 February 2024); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/50d464c03a6e42edb650f994e0d31985ddd171c5/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif holotable commit 50d464c], 25 February 2024) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Like My Father Before Me from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Anakin 'communing,' you may initiate battles for free.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” although it is the first image of this alternate-image card; the mark is the base card's errata mark (the alternate image reprints the errata text of [[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre]]), not a count of this card's versions. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (ALT) (Errata)]]): Card image published 20 January 2026 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/076a22983acae39b3fb94c0785c05a8a9445d9b7/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png holotable commit 076a229], 20 January 2026); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif holotable commit 6cae8c9], 20 January 2026) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Like My Father Before Me from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
